bullets.text: Premier League Soccer: Stream Live - **West Ham** faces **Aston Villa** in a crucial match this Sunday.
iOS 26.2 Introduces AirDrop Codes - New feature enhances **AirDrop** security with one-time codes for unknown contacts.
iRobot Files for Bankruptcy - After 35 years, **iRobot** enters Chapter 11, to be acquired by **Picea Robotics**.
WhatsApp Faces Regulatory Challenges - New Indian government rules could disrupt **WhatsApp** functionality for millions.
Shazam Launches Popular Segments - New feature reveals which moments in songs captivate listeners the most.
Netflix Blocks Phone-to-TV Streaming - Users must now launch the app directly on TVs to watch content.
Spinny to Acquire GoMechanic - Indian startup **Spinny** raises $160M to finance the acquisition of **GoMechanic**.
Apple Glasses Rumored Features - Anticipation builds for **Apple's** upcoming smart glasses with innovative capabilities.
